source.title: Mass prospecting/Milling queue'ing addons? (original Dragonflight Draconium prospecting comment)

quote: I get around 10-15 rank 3's per 15,000 draconium
notes: HELD; newly acquired original first-person historical comment, not an exact yield cohort. One commenter reports roughly 10-15 R3 Illimited Diamonds per 15,000 nominal Draconium ore usually, plus an unlucky recent interval with roughly 3-4 R3 diamonds per 15,000 nominal ore. These are approximate ranges, not independently enumerated outcomes or independent cohorts. Same commenter says R1 or R2 Draconium can be used depending on price, but the exact ore-rank mixture for these batches is unknown. No completed casts, output-event counts, zeros, exact output totals, or Resourcefulness refunded inputs; Inspiration ~25% with candle and Resourcefulness ~5% were reported as stats, with changing equipment. Do not use as measured drop rate, exact totalQuantity, per-cast mean or 0-1+ histogram; never convert nominal ore/5 to observed casts. Recipe batch size 5 sourced independently from https://www.wowhead.com/spell=374627/dragon-isles-prospecting; output rank-3 identity independently corroborated at https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/192871. This source is not among the 725 assigned pre-cutoff source keys in the 2026-11-20 manifest. Original commenter handle and exact collection dates not reliably resolved.
specialization: Enterprising and Prospecting fully allocated; remaining points unspecified
stats: Author reports approximately 25% Inspiration with candle, 5% Resourcefulness; equipment changed over time
